body: The capture/restore bug (reading/writing through the shim's own proxy) was found only because the user asked what 'use here' does. Grep for every executeScript into the MAIN world and confirm it either goes through window.__mstabsSession's handle or deliberately wants the proxied view. Apply the rule-4 habit: fix the CLASS, not the instance.
title: Audit every other place that touches page storage through window.*
